mandatoryFindings.title: Attempt marker precedes current SAME-holder qualification
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Guarded actual capture writes admission-capture-attempt.json before held raises SYNTHETIC_HOLDER_CHANGED.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Qualify fresh exact holder/controller/observer-parent/FD/dev/inode/kernel and custody/umask before any output; retain exclusive cap1 marker and fail/partial HOLD.

mandatoryFindings.title: Holder lsof output omits returned PID validation
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Actual held fake accepts correct PID, different PID and missing PID when the inode line matches.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Require exact returned wrapper PID with associated FD/inode fields, keeping options-first argv and strict zero/nonempty/empty-error rules.

mandatoryFindings.title: Verified hash and interpreted source/JSON use different reads
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Second CORE buffer executes added import after expected hash; second candidate read reclassifies unknown resident as inherited. Baseline split independently mapped from source without actual baseline access.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Use same custody-verified buffer for hash and interpretation across all reachable code/immutable metadata sites; map the reached sites and supply verified baseline in memory to imported reader.

mandatoryFindings.title: Observation timeout implicitly sends kill
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Adapter calls run(timeout=10); inspected standard-library branch calls process.kill then wait. No real child/signal used.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Use no-signal observation timeout/failure handling with honest child identity/completion/UNKNOWN accounting; preserve version adapter no-signal semantics.
